title: Closeness to a signed dictator
statement: Let $n>0$ and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$. If $\varepsilon\ge 0$ and the three-way ranking test accepts $f$ with probability $1-\varepsilon$, then there are a coordinate $i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$ and a choice of whether to negate it such that the relative Hamming distance from $f$ to that signed dictator is at most $7205\varepsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps sign vectors of length $n$ to signs
The test's acceptance probability on $f$ is $1-\varepsilon$
